Alfred.name: Alfred
Alfred.quote: Fighting monsters makes you stronger. As you kill monsters you gain experience and you can level up. You can also get better weapons and armor to make you powerful. Also, if you press down while on solid ground, you can slide. Practice it out on this incline.

Alpipa.name: Alpipa
Alpipa.quote: What do you want? No you don't know me but you've probably met my brother Anoop, so don't call me Anoop because it's not my name. So what do you want? Are you just going to stand there and look at me? This ain't a nice place to be, so if you want something you better buy it or scram!

Andrew.name: Andrew
Andrew.quote: Welcome to Mushroom Village! I love it here, they've got weapon and armor shops, food, hotels, and even a few pretty girls.

Anoop.name: Anoop
Anoop.quote: V'elcome my friend, to my end of the woods! Pretty cool place I have wouldn't you say? This is where I live, eating leaves and drinking dirt all day. ...Nah, I'm just kidding I don't drink dirt. Anyways, I have some things for sale. Maybe you would like to take a look?

Arny.name: Arny
Arny.quote: Hey man, how's it going? I like just being at beach, it's so relaxing. I need to get up and go somewhere at some point though, it's making me so lazy. I haven't seen my pal Cleveland in a few months now. Say... I have a letter for him, do you think you could give it to him for me? He lives in Mushroom Village. Thanks!

Barbara.name: Barbara
Barbara.quote: Hello. If you plan on fighting anybody in the PVP areas then it's best to be at full health. I can heal you.

Bartholomew.name: Bartholomew
Bartholomew.quote: Welcome to my home and shop. I live here out in the darkness and I make a living from selling beholder and other high level items. Dark Beholders are very very strong creatures. It's an amazing thing that you've made it here. Perhaps I can interest you in some equipment?

Ben.name: Ben
Ben.quote: I like to chill. No... I LOVE to chill. I think I'm a chill guy don't you? If I had a coin for everytime I said the word chill, I'd have about 1 coin in total. Wait, that's not right...

Bert.name: Bert
Bert.quote: If you press and hold the P key near trees you will see two bars above them. The top blue bar is the tree's evolution bar. The bottom is its health.

Betty.name: Betty
Betty.quote: Aqualantis is an amazing city. It's where everyone starts their fishing journey. Perhaps I could heal you?

Billbert.name: Billbert
Billbert.quote: Good work solving my puzzle. And by the way, watch out for Carnelia, she's mean! Along with puzzles, I also like random facts. Did you know that the skull crusher items are made from the bones of night stalkers? The bones are then chemically infused with super strong metals to make them even tougher than beholder items.

Blaire.name: Blaire
Blaire.quote: Out here in the wastelands is a scary place. Not only is it scary, but it's empty. It's so empty I get bored just standing here. I tell you what, sometimes I even get so bored I just punch myself in the face for fun. Doesn't sound like a bad idea does it? Watch yourself out here, Night Stalkers aren't friendly enemies. One of my friends caught one and kept it as a pet. The next day, it ate him for breakfast. You better believe it.

Bobby.name: Bobby
Bobby.quote: I like to stay in here away from the Dark Beholders and Kreetons.

Brad Anderson.name: Brad Anderson
Brad Anderson.quote: My two cousins Ron and Kyle just argue all day. It's really annoying. The thing is, I'm not sure who to agree with. In my opinion, I like to stack my HP, that way I never die.

Brody.name: Brody
Brody.mission: Get Brody a Garbage Can Lid
Brody.quote: Bro, dude, man. Like... I love the garbage can lid dude. Not because I like the smell of garbage or anything... Actually dude, that's exactly why.

Butch.name: Butch
Butch.quote: Hey you! Have you seen anything suspicious going on?

Carter.name: Carter
Carter.quote: Hey man, can't a guy climb some boxes in peace!?

Cassie.name: Cassie
Cassie.quote: WE NEED A QUOTATION FOR WHEN SHE GIVES THE PLAYER THE MISSION?

Chad.name: Chad
Chad.quote: I love it out here. It's so nice and peaceful by the water. Do you travel a lot? I have heard there are guilds in Mushroom Village. Is it true? If so, I want to join one! I think it'd be cool to make some new friends.

Chance.name: Chance
Chance.quote: I've got some top quality stuff for sale if you're interested. I bet you could use it if you plan on taking down any of them frogs.

Charles.name: Charles
Charles.quote: Welcome to my hotel. With a good nights sleep, we can heal you back to full health.

Chipper.name: Chipper
Chipper.quote: Be careful going into there, it's very dangerous. You can be attacked by anybody in there and if you die, you will loose half of your money. One day, I'll be strong enough to destroy anybody in there! Right now, I'm kind of scared though... If you want to get onto the kill leaderboards, PVP kills only count in this area, NOT the sparring grounds.

Chris.name: Chris
Chris.quote: All I want to do is watch some TV. Is that too much to ask? The stupid thing must be broke, because it's not turning on!

Christy.name: Christy
Christy.quote: Welcome to the Pet Adoption District. Here you find a bunch of pets that other players have placed up for adoption.

Chucky.name: Chucky
Chucky.quote: E.V.I.L.? You don't know what it stands for? What are you dumb? Everybody knows that E.V.I.L. stands for... it stands for... Elephant... Violin... Image... Lemon. Wait, that might be a little bit off.

Clark.name: Clark
Clark.quote: You know, I was thinking about it. I think you may have tricked me, there is no Lost Warrior anymore is there? Or is there?

Cleveland.name: Cleveland
Cleveland.quote: I love Mushroom Village. I like to call it "Mush Vill" for short. I think it sounds way cooler. Just say it with me, "Mush Vill". Feels great doesn't it? You can thank me later.

Dan.name: Dan
Dan.quote: Wooo! It's hotter than a Magmagon's rear end after eating a habanero!

Daniel.name: Daniel
Daniel.quote: Through this portal is the Training Grounds. There you can be attacked by anybody, but luckily if you die no money will be taken away. Sometimes I go in there to spar against my buddies and see who will win.

Derek.name: Derek
Derek.quote: Wow!! You hit an energy level over 9,000! You're nuts! I wish I could be as powerful as you... I've seen guys even higher than 9,000 though. The strongest guy I've ever seen was around 17,000. CRAZY POWERFUL

Donald.name: Donald
Donald.quote: Have you ever noticed it smells kind of weird when you're underwater?

Drew.name: Drew
Drew.quote: I like to stand right in the sunlight. It makes me feel like I'm cool. I mean, even if I didn't stand in the sunlight, I'd still be cool, but I'm even cooler when I'm in the light.

Fredward.name: Fredward
Fredward.quote: I gave you your money, so leave me alone.

Gary.name: Gary
Gary.quote: Coconut this, coconut that.. All the boss has me do all day is make stuff out of coconuts while he climbs up and down on his boxes. He calls the guy next door crazy, yet he's growing a coconut tree inside a house!

Gellius.name: Gellius
Gellius.quote: Welcome, welcome! I am the creator of the widely known "Guild system"! If you would like to join or create a guild, you can do it through me. If you join, create, or leave a guild, you may have to leave this house before your guild flag appears or goes away.

Geraldo.name: Geraldo
Geraldo.quote: Welcome to my tree fort. I live out here in the rain forest away from everyone else. It's peaceful out here but it can be very dangerous. Some people come here just to see the Lotus Eyes, then shortly after they wind up in the hospital or dead. Be careful out here, it's a dangerous place in the rain forest. Say, do you need to buy anything? I specialize in a many variety of food and potions.

Gordon.name: Gordon
Gordon.quote: Thanks for the watermelons man, they were delicious

Hambone.name: Hambone
Hambone.quote: Thanks for the apples, they were delicious.

Hamlet.name: Hamlet
Hamlet.quote: This acid is rough out here. It burns, it's slippery, and it makes me trip. It'd make a good addition to a weapon though. Image you covered your weapon in acid. Ouch! I've got some things I can sell and craft for you. It's good to keep a stock of equipment out here in a dangerous place like this

Howard.name: Howard
Howard.quote: Through this portal is a GVG area. It allows guilds to fight other guilds. If you go there with a fellow guild member, you won't be able to hurt them! This makes it easy to team up on other players from other guilds. Like the sparring grounds, money is not lost if you die in here. If you kill somebody in here and you are in a guild, you will add one to your guild total kills.

Hubert.name: Hubert
Hubert.quote: It's a hot, mean, nasty world out here.

Jenkins.name: Jenkins
Jenkins.quote: I bet you could use some strong equipment! There's no doubt you will need it in a savage place like this. I can offer you some, but you must pay a hefty price.

Jim Sanders.name: Jim Sanders
Jim Sanders.quote: Hey, gingers DO have souls! ...And sickles.

Jimmy.name: Jimmy
Jimmy.quote: You know me, I love graffiti! Hopefully I don't get busted for painting on random things. Oh well!

Joshua.name: Joshua
Joshua.quote: There are so many types of monsters, I which I could see them all. Some of them are so powerful though, I'm afraid I might get knocked out if I get too close. Say, when you filled your Hero-Pedia up with all of the monsters info do you think you could show me? I love to learn about all the new monsters there are!

Keith.name: Keith
Keith.quote: Hey buddy, I don't like you. Why? I don't need a reason! This is our hideout, and if anyone dislikes it, I will pinch them!

Kris.name: Kris
Kris.quote: Welcome to Cloud Kingdom the most fascinating place in all of the world. Even though it is a purely beautiful place, there still lurks the omega fluffs in all corners.

Kyle Anderson.name: Kyle Anderson
Kyle Anderson.quote: My brother Ron likes to be 'well rounded', but I just call him 'well idiot'. Like I always say, the best defense is a good offense!

Lamar.name: Lamar
Lamar.quote: So have you caught Every fish type yet?

Larry.name: Larry
Larry.quote: Robo City sure is a cool place to be isn't it? It's even cooler to live in Robo City. I do all the paper work for the robots. When a robot creates another robot, there is a lot of paperwork that is involved. What else would I have all of these drawers for? They hold all my paperwork.

Lewis.name: Lewis
Lewis.quote: They say there is no power greater than knowledge. So why not read? You never know, it may help you out.

Lottery Man.name: Lottery Man
Lottery Man.quote: Hello there! Would you like to be rich beyond your wildest dreams?

Margret.name: Margret
Margret.quote: Cold, cold, cold! You want healed young one? I can heal you. If you plan on going through that portal to the right, you're going to need it

Markus.name: Markus
Markus.quote: A pet is a man's best friend. Each pet has 3 different modes available to choose from. Choose the mode that best fits your playing style. During their 3rd form, some pets can even be ridden. Would you like to give one of our precious pets a new home?

Martin.name: Martin
Martin.quote: I love my pets. Even though pets can be very good fighters, you must always love them and treat them as you would like to be treated. A loved pet also makes a stronger pet. When a pet's love is high, it has a better chance of gaining more whenever it levels up. So always make sure to keep your pet's love meter up. And also, choose your companion wisely. You cannot remove a pet as your companion unless you permanently release him. A pet that is your companion will feel extra loved, therefore making him potentially strong than your other pets.

Maxwell.name: Maxwell
Maxwell.quote: Welcome to Robo City, home of the robos. In Robo City, electricity rules all. If you mess with the robos or their electricity, things could get ugly.

Michael.name: Michael
Michael.quote: I think I'm pretty strong but this area next to me is pretty tough. Make sure you got some good gear and are strong enough to fight the enemies in there.

Milton.name: Milton
Milton.quote: Welcome to my fishing castle. It's not a very big castle, but I still like to call it a castle. Have you been fishing lately? If not, you're going to need a fishing pole. One pole is all you need, but you have to train your fishing skills to become better. So how about you buy a fishing pole from me?

Mizon.name: Mizon
Mizon.mission: The Black Hooded Hatchet & Find the Cult's Hideout

Mystic.name: Mystic
Mystic.quote: This is the biggest, baddest, cult you will EVER find in your ENTIRE life. We have everything you could ever need here. Trees, ground, graves, trees and a massive 4 foot clubhouse big enought to fit at least 200 people. Luckily I get to chill in the clubhouse all day. ..If you are here looking for Mad Ricky, he's not here right now.

Ned.name: Ned
Ned.quote: Cutting down trees is good for harnessing their wood, but be sure to plant trees as well.

Nicolas.name: Nicolas
Nicolas.quote: Pets pets pets! You should always treat pets with love and respect. A pets base stats are indicative of stats throughout their life as they level up. This means, if one pet has a higher power than another, it is more likely to increase its power during a level up. Anyway, would you like to adopt some pets?

Pablo.name: Pablo
Pablo.quote: I love the monster skull you got for me. Thanks man, I love you. Wow wow! Not like that.

Patrick.name: Patrick
Patrick.quote: Even though I know I'll never see my Tebra again, it sure would make me happy to see someone with a smile on their face riding a pet they love.

Philbert.name: Philbert
Philbert.quote: You must find this person, and wear the same shirt as them.

R.J..name: R.J.
R.J..quote: Here are some billboards of the top level players and records in Emberfall. These guys are the best of the best, the cream of the crop. The top guilds board at the end fo the room is calculated by adding the levels of all players in a guild. It is updated several times a week, so if you cain a level, change members, or anything of that nature it will not be updated immediately. Also, in order to be featured as a statue, you must be a minimum level of

Ralph.name: Ralph
Ralph.quote: Welcome to the wonderful world of Emberfall! Here you will find plenty of other people from around the world to interact with!

Rebecca.name: Rebecca
Rebecca.quote: Hello traveler. Do you need to be healed? I can heal you, I am a trained and licensed nurse. Here you are, back to full health.

Ricardo.name: Ricardo
Ricardo.quote: Weapons, armor, helmets. I've got it all! Most people come to check out Petropolis for its pets, but I like to sell equipment in hopes that they'll spend their money with me. Hehe! If you buy a helmet, Ill give you half of a 2 year old already chewed up browny made from dirt. Sounds like one awesome deal doesn't it? Ok, maybe I'm lying, but you should still buy something.

Ron Anderson.name: Ron Anderson
Ron Anderson.quote: My brother Kyle stacked all his attack, now when he gets hit by enemies he takes a lot of damage. I think he's dumb for doing it, I like to balance everything out.

Ronald.name: Ronald
Ronald.quote: ...for now you have to find the guy that cut down the platform you were on. He was carrying a hatchet and dressed in full black so he shouldn't be hard to find. If you don't find him soon he's going to cause mischief in our village.

Sales Man.name: Sales Man
Sales Man.quote: Welcome to my store. Please buy whatever you would like.

Sam Shoe.name: Sam Shoe
Sam Shoe.quote: Shoes shoes shoes! Get your shoes here! You wanna buy some shoes man?

Samuel.name: Samuel
Samuel.quote: Just like us humans, there are many different ways to set up your pet! Pet helmets are much like us human's helmets, however since pets don't have range or magic, instead they have luck and healing. You'll find that archer based items usually increase a pet's luck, as where magician based items usually increase its healing ability. The luck helps give the owner a better chance of receiving drops from enemies. The healing allows the pet to heal the owner more health every so often. Sometimes when my pet levels up it doesn't gain any points, which stinks. But sometims it gains a lot!

Scarlet.name: Scarlet
Scarlet.quote: Do you think now that I got this hockey mask that I can smash my head off of anything I want and it won't hurt? Oh... well neither did I.

Shane Shield.name: Shane Shield
Shane Shield.quote: Welcome, welcome! I am Shane the Shield Man, or Shane Shield for short. You came all the way to my house, surely you are interested in buying some shields?

Sneed.name: Sneed
Sneed.quote: There's no way you came down here and risked your life Not to buy something!

Snoop.name: Snoop
Snoop.quote: I put that 'store' sign in my house in case anybody came in and couldn't find me. It's what I like to call a great idea.

Susan.name: Susan
Susan.quote: Weapons and healing all in one place! Pretty handy isn't it? I'll heal you. Don't worry, I'm a licensed professional.

Tanner.name: Tanner
Tanner.quote: You are in the biggest building not only in Petopia, but the biggest building on Elandra Island. Here in this building we raise pets. You can adopt them here. Here are the ones I have ready for adoption.

Tanya.name: Tanya
Tanya.quote: This is a dangerous place around these parts. I'm going to take a good guess and say you could use healed.

Ted.name: Ted
Ted.quote: All pets are born with the natural ability to teleport. This is a unique ability they have that seperates them from the enemy world. When a pet gets too far from you or is confused, they will often teleport to be next to you. You can even tell the pet to teleport by pressing the Q key. Remember that it can often come in handy. Aren't pets amazing creatures? Would you like to adopt a new friend?

Thomas.name: Thomas
Thomas.quote: Are you getting the hang of things? This area is what they call Mushroom Alley. I wish I were a mushroom.

Tiberius.name: Tiberius
Tiberius.quote: ...And people told me this was a bad place to open up shop, ha!

Toddwell.name: Toddwell
Toddwell.quote: Weapons... That is the only thing that will help you tackle these super wicked Omega Fluffs. They may have a charming name, but let me tell you what.. They will rip you a new one!

Train Shack Man.name: Train Shack Man
Train Shack Man.quote: I'm what they call a train-o-holic'. It costs $1,000 to ride. Trains arrive here 3 minutes before they depart.

Travis.name: Travis
Travis.quote: I could sell you some weapons, they will help warm you up! ...Oh weapons don't warm you up? Well buy some anyway.

Tristan.name: Tristan
Tristan.quote: If you buy a pet, be very careful with them. A new pet starts at level one, so don't take them into areas with monsters too strong for them. Think about it, would you try and fight strong monsters if you were level one? No! So don't be mean and make a pet fight a monster that will hurt him! Also, did you know that a pet's feet are close to the same size as us humans? That means they can wear the same shoes as we can! One last thing. A pet feels more love the more pets you have. Pets like being with other pets, so it's always good to own several pets.

Val.name: Val
Val.quote: I hate being on the bottom floor. Why can't I sell stuff on the top floor? Oh well. Anyway, I specialize in selling pet helmets. Are there any I could interest you in?

Vince.name: Vince
Vince.quote: Did you know, that inactive pets still play an important role? Inactive pets that are not knocked out can use their spirit to effect their owner. We like to call them 'pet spirit orbs'. The orbs grow bigger and stronger as a pet levels up. These orbs add to a user's power, range, and magic.

Viper.name: Viper
Viper.quote: Welcome... to the future! Well, not really but everyone here loves robots and technology. I am the local weapon and armor shop guy. Can I interest you in anything?

Wallace.name: Wallace
Wallace.quote: Them great frogs can be tough you know. You have to have some of the top level gear in order to survive against them.

Walter.name: Walter
Walter.quote: Pets Pets Pets! They're so awesome! There are keys to keeping your pet happy and keeping his love up as much as possible. Pets as you can imagine, like food. Food can help raise their love. Also it's very mean to let a pet die. Pets also get sad if they don't get used often. You know what's the worst though? Not using a pet and leaving him passed out with 0 health. That will surely lower their love fast. A pet's love is a hard thing to manage, so don't study it too carefully because you never can tell. Some people drive themselves MAD trying to get the pet's love perfect.

Wayne.name: Wayne
Wayne.quote: People call us folks who live in Fairyville weird, but I don't think we're weird, we're just odd that's all. Some people even call us dumb, but we ain't dumb, we stupid. It doesn't even make me angry when people talk about us, it just makes me mad. People need to stop.

William.name: William
William.quote: Finally, you're up! Mad Ricky and his Green Bouncers are back and they're trying to chop down our forest again! A few of his Green Bouncers are on their way back over here, they crave blood! Get up!

Wilson.name: Wilson
Wilson.quote: You don't have what it takes to complete my triple dog dare? Can't you collect 7 pets? Maybe I will collect them before you do.

Wood Man Steve.name: Wood Man Steve
Wood Man Steve.quote: I, like my brother Wood Man Tim, Also can help you craft processed wood. You will need 10 of a log to make it into good wood that can be crafted with. By the way did you know fish are a vital part of crafting ? The fish dont get killed or smooshed into equipment, they are just needed as scales and body contain important DNA that must be replicated when crafting weapons and armour. That way fish arent harmed. Now what can i help you with?

Wood Man Tim.name: Wood Man Tim
Wood Man Tim.quote: ...here at Pablo's I can refine and process those logs into ready-to-use wood.
